title: The goal line is closed to a puck that rides with its carrier (first form of patch 0002)
hypothesis: A quarter of thirdjam's hand's goals are walked over the line (PLAY 1), and the planning hand finds the same play unprompted (0.33 of its 2.27 goals a match at pro). Closing both goal lines to a puck that rides with its carrier (thirdjam already does exactly this for the defending side at its own net, game.puck.net.own_wall) sends every goal through the finishing game thirdjam already has: the tap the crease man saves, the charged shot over him, the deke that moves him, the one-timer. Expected: walk-in goals 0 for every hand and both sides (T1); a hand with every shot taken away scores almost nothing (T2: at least 30 pp lost at pro, from 8); the planning hand turns its walk-ins into shots and loses little; thirdjam's scripted hand, which cannot re-plan, loses its walked goals; possession, carries and knockdowns do not move.
tempo: none: no row of the tempo map moves (the gym probes are equal)

table: | cell | win % | goal diff | gf/min | ga/min | walk-in goals / match | shots/min | pass compl % | passes/min | one-timers / match | carry s | carries lost % | takes key / no key per min | knockdowns | down s | changes/min | match s | paired: wins pp, goal diff |

why: The rule leaked. It closed the line only while the puck was riding with its carrier (UJamSim::RidingCarrier: within 4 m/s of his velocity). At the wall the puck bounces, stops riding, and his own body then pushes it over. Walked goals fell by about half, not to zero: thirdjam's regular hand at pro 0.58 -> 0.22 a match, the planning hand 0.33 -> 0.20; with every shot taken away the hands still scored 0.53 and 0.68 goals a match. The idea stands (T2 moved as predicted: taking the shot away cost thirdjam's hand 30 points of wins instead of 8), the mechanism did not. Rewritten and measured again as E01b.
notes: Measured on the first form of patch 0002 (arm epoch k8-1); the patch file in the tree is the rewritten one. 60 seeds a cell.
